topic: Parts and functions of the skin
key_concepts: Skin is the outer covering of the body
Skin protects the body from injuries and infection
Skin helps prevent loss of too much water
The skin has two layers: epidermis and dermis
The epidermis is the outer layer with dead skin cells
The dermis is the inner layer containing blood vessels, nerves, sweat glands, and oil glan
Sweat glands open on the skin surface through pores
Oil glands keep hair and skin soft and moist
Nerves send messages to the brain
Nerve endings sense touch, pain, pressure, and temperature
